## Workflow and problem

Who is trying to do what? Describe the observed failure and current workaround without private identifying details.

## Evidence and desired outcome

Separate observed facts from assumptions and requests. Describe what would show that the problem was resolved.

## Scope and alternatives

Name the smallest useful change, alternatives and relevant compatibility or security effects. A simulator, interface, result or production-data proposal should address its roadmap entry gate.

## Public-data check

- [ ] I have permission to share the supplied material and removed confidential and identifying data.
